subject: Commit grooming playbook & lead-review ticketing
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Theresa Wong <theresa.wong@acme.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Commit grooming playbook & lead-review ticketing

Hi all —

We need to kick off the November commit grooming cycle and collect the leadership review pack for the upcoming QBR. Goal is a clean, auditable leader-facing packet by end of next week so Finance and GTM leadership can sign off. Key asks below: please read and ack in-thread.

What I need from each manager (Laura/Marcus/Grace):
- Populate the attached scrub-pack-template.xlsx for every open commit you intend to present. Use the "Commit Status" column to mark: "Confirm", "At-Risk", or "Pull".
- Attach the most recent commit evidence (PO, SOW, signed email) as links in the template or list filenames in the Evidence column.
- If you expect a price/term deviation, flag it in the "Escalation" column and include the expected delta.
- Create a HubSpot ticket (see link below) for any commit that requires legal/procurement follow-up. Put the ticket ID into the spreadsheet.

Deadlines and cadence:
- Spreadsheet populated and uploaded to the Drive folder by EOD Tuesday, 24 Nov 2026.
- Manager dry-run (15m each) on Wed 25 Nov; consolidated leadership pack built on Thu 26 Nov.
- Final leadership packet delivered to execs on Mon 30 Nov.

Meeting: I scheduled a short kickoff to align owners and ticketing practice — Nov 22, 11:00-11:30 PT. Invite should be in your calendars. If that time absolutely won't work for you, let me know by EOD today.

Attachments (stubs): [Attachment: scrub-pack-template.xlsx (xlsx, 48KB)], [Attachment: commit-list-export.csv (csv, 120KB)]
Links: Drive folder - https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ScrubPack_Template, HubSpot tickets - https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/ticket/98765

Thanks — please acknowledge?

— Avery
Avery Johnson
Sr. Manager, GTM Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Theresa Wong <theresa.wong@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Commit grooming playbook & lead-review ticketing

Avery — thanks for the clear checklist. Acked. A couple quick clarifications: 

1) For evidence links, is it acceptable to paste a Confluence or Drive pointer rather than attaching? (Prefer links so we don't duplicate files.)
2) For net-new deals where finance is awaiting PO, should I mark them "At-Risk" or "Hold"?

I'll start with our west-region commit list and expect to have the sheet uploaded by Monday evening (22 Nov) — earlier than the hard deadline.

On the kickoff, 11:00 PT works for me.

Laura Bennett
Manager, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Thanks for the quick responses. Confirming decisions and next steps: 

- Laura, thanks for the early upload plan. Links instead of attachments are perfect — Drive links are preferred.
- Marcus / Rachel: appreciate the callout. Rachel, please add the AR aging CSV to the Drive folder by Friday 20 Nov; if not possible, reply with ETA and we'll flag those rows for leadership review.
- Grace: please own the central ticketing pattern and ensure HubSpot ticket IDs are added to the template column.

I'll compile all manager sheets into the leadership packet on Thu 26 Nov and circulate a final review on Fri 27 Nov for a Monday executive push. If any commit is marked "At-Risk" with >$250k delta, I'll escalate to Derek and Finance directly.

One operational note: please name your uploaded files with this prefix: <region>_<rep>_commitpack_YYYYMMDD (example: east_marcus_commitpack_20261122.xlsx). It keeps the assembly script happy.

Thanks — see you on the 22nd kickoff call.

Avery
Sr. Manager, GTM Operations
Redwood Inference
